EVE

EVE (FT8xx / BT8xx) related repositories

The EVE graphics engine brings display, audio and touch together with a single command coprocessor. Explore sample apps, GUI frameworks and language bindings.

Official samples and examples

  • EveApps

    Official sample and demo applications
  • pico-brteve

    C, CPython and CircuitPython for Pico
  • Eve-MCU-Dev

    C library for embedded designs
  • py-bteve

    CircuitPython built-in _EVE class

GUI Framework

  • nuklear_eve

    Immediate-mode GUI on EVE
  • LVGL-Eve

    LVGL ported to EVE

Arduino library

  • RP2040-BrtEve

    Arduino library for RP2040 and EVE

Telemetrix

  • telemetrix-rpi-pico

    Client running on a PC (Windows / Linux / Mac)
  • Telemetrix4RpiPico

    Server running on an RP2040 MCU connected to EVE

BT82x

  • EveApps-BT82X

    C/C++ sample applications for BT82x
  • python-bt82x-dev

    Python development for BT82x
